create_chatgpt_config: create a ChatGPTConfig instance to configure authentication and API settings for ChatGPT
get_openai_compatible_provider_info: get dynamic API base and access token from the ChatGPT authenticator for OpenAI-compatible requests
validate_chatgpt_environment: validate the ChatGPT environment and return merged default headers with account and session IDs
normalize_chatgpt_stream: normalize a ChatGPT streaming response to extract and process tool calls from the stream
map_chatgpt_openai_params: map OpenAI-compatible parameters for ChatGPT with stream defaulting to false
